name: Junk Level 8 Synchro
description:
3x Junk Meister
1x Junk Armor
2x Stardust Synchron
1-2x Junk Signal
1x Stardust Dragon OR Stardust Charge Warrior
You can either use the smaller package or play the full package for multiple synchros, in which case you add:
2x Junk Synchron
1-3x Synchro Fellowship
1-3x Full-Speed Warrior
1x Assault Sonic Warrior
